text:
Maya: FYI NewBridge wants a joint co-sell POC next week. Use-case: multi-tenant support assistant with embeddings + reranking + generation. They need SSO (SAML), optional VPC peer, latency SLO for 95th < 350ms, expected steady QPS ~30, burst up to 180. Pilot target: 40k tokens/day. They also asked about short-term pilot pricing (90 days) vs 6mo commitment. Can eng/presales/security triage?

Linda: I'll handle commercial. Need quick delta: hosted vs reserved. Also they requested a simple SLA summary for pilot reporting (latency, uptime, telemetry cadence).

Raj: I can run the presales POC. Questions: what model family (open quantized vs licensed)? context window expectations? also want partner contact. Any compliance/regional constraints?

Maya: Contact is Priya (priya@newbridge.ai). They're planning a quantized open-weights 30-70B family. Typical prompts ~300 tokens, occasionally 1200 tokens. Mix of embeddings + generation + light rerank. Regional: EU preference but pilot can run in us-east if needed.

Elaine: From runtime ops: suggest two options: 1) Hosted trial to demo in 48h using quant8 builds + KV prefix caching (fastest); 2) Dedicated reserved pool for predictable 95th ≤350ms. For their burst I'd provision 2 x A10-equivalent nodes with autoscale burst to 4 for stress tests. Will instrument KV cache metrics.

Elaine: Network allowlist snippet for their infra folks to paste:
```
# Allowlist
Outbound: 18.205.44.12/32, 3.120.11.33/32
TLS: 443 to *.redwood-inference.com
VPC peering: request peer CIDR 10.50.0.0/16
```

Tom: Security checklist / blockers:
- Must complete partner security questionnaire before privileged access.
- SAML: need IdP metadata XML and test user; ACS URL will be per-environment (we'll provide).
- Data residency: if EU processing required, we'll spin up dedicated eu-west-1 nodes or Private.
- Need their SOC2/pen-test artifact; if unavailable, limit pilot to sandbox hosted or Private deployment.

Linda: Can we get a rough cost example to send procurement? Pilot (90d) and commit (6mo) numbers please. Also what support SLAs apply to pilot?

Raj: Quick back-of-envelope (subject to finance SKU):
- Hosted pilot: assume $0.012 / 1k tokens -> 40k tokens/day => ~$0.48/day -> ~$14/mo (this looks low since it's per 1k tokens; sanity check: actually 40k tokens/day = 40 * $0.012 = $0.48/day -> ~$14/mo). Latency varies with concurrency.
- Dedicated reserved (2x A10-eq): baseline ~$15k/mo; we can offer 10-20% pilot discount for 3mo and 20-30% for 6mo commit. Reserved bundles include support & monitoring.
I'll confirm SKUs with finance tomorrow.

Elaine: POC runbook outline I'll produce: load profile (steady 30 qps, spikes to 180 qps for 2 min), success metrics (95th latency, error rate <1%, KV cache hit >50%), telemetry endpoints, regression triggers. Canary fallback rule snippet:
```
route_policy:
  primary: dedicated-2node
  fallback: hosted-quant8
  max_latency_ms: 350
```

Tom: I'll start the questionnaire and request NewBridge's legal/security contact and dataflow diagram. Also note: if they want long-term EU residency, include eu pricing variant.

Maya: Timeline: partner asks for a demo env by Mon and joint demo Wed. Can infra provision short-lived workspace and temp creds?

infra-bot: Workspace created: id=rwh-poc-2801, creds expire in 6 days. Telemetry endpoint: https://api.redwood-inference.com/workspaces/rwh-poc-2801/telemetry.

Raj: I'll prepare sample prompts, a small eval harness to measure quality drift, and a minimal dataset for reranking tests. Need SAML metadata and a small test user list by tomorrow EOD.

Linda: I'll draft an SOW template with pilot deliverables, reporting cadence (weekly perf summary), and a provisional price table (hosted pilot, dedicated pilot, 6mo commit).

Elaine: I'll post the runbook doc link and the initial load script (k6 + curl shim) in this thread by EOD. Also will include exact node sizing and memory estimates for quantized models.

Maya: Action items: Elaine runbook & infra provisioning, Raj prompts + eval harness, Tom sec questionnaire, Linda SOW & pricing. I'll coordinate partner scheduling and own demo. Ping me if blocked. :rocket:
